data.why: The tool is a manual data-entry form (select dropdowns for GRADE domain judgments); it has no file upload, no example dataset, and no data-loading code to seed.

goals: Enter risk-of-bias, inconsistency, indirectness, imprecision, and publication-bias downgrade judgments for a randomized-trial outcome and get the resulting certainty rating
Enter a non-randomized (observational) body of evidence with no downgrades and apply upgrading factors (large effect, dose-response gradient, opposing confounding) to see certainty rise from low
Confirm that upgrading options are disabled/ineligible once any downgrade is present or the study design starts high
Export the completed assessment as a local JSON file and verify its contents match the on-screen judgment breakdown
Reset the form and re-run a different combination of judgments to compare resulting certainty categories (very low vs. low vs. moderate vs. high)

review.summary: This is an accurate, well-worded tree of a simple GRADE certainty calculator, and the screens I opened all match their nodes. It needs light restructuring before filing: move the misplaced default calculation out of t1, remove or demote the UI-testing tasks (t4 and t7), and show the exported file as evidence.
